selection: Evaluate every eligible xKiro candidate on a fresh full development set, without reading or writing answer-cache successes. Select by refusal, rubric, validation and client latency before holdout. KiosAPI is explicitly deferred until Free-group routing is available. Existing held-out results may be reused only for exactly identical requests; not fresh validation.
free_policy: Recheck live pricing. xKiro: free access tier and zero input/output/cache charges. KiosAPI: SKU exclusively in Free group with zero group multiplier and no billing expression. Never strip :free or fall back to a paid SKU.

skip_providers.kiosapi: Previous run returned model_not_found for Free-only SKUs under group default (distributor). Await a token permitted to use Free; no further identical retries.
